connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

db.title: Metadata database
db.description: Connection to the SQL database server hosting the Airflow metadata database.

metadataSecret.title: Metadata connection secret
metadataSecret.description: Secret with key connection holding the full SQLAlchemy connection string.

oidcRoleMapping.title: Role mapping
oidcRoleMapping.description: Map of OIDC groups to lists of Airflow roles.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: Connection to the S3-compatible object store the DAGs read and write.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey and secretKey granting the DAGs access to the object store.

dagsGitSync.title: Git sync
dagsGitSync.description: Chart dags.gitSync values (the scalar keys listed here). Unquoted true/false is a boolean, an unquoted number is an int/float, quote to force a string. ref is mirrored onto branch. credentialsSecret.name carries the git credentials Secret name.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

airflow.title: airflow
airflow.description: Values of the airflow chart 1.22.0 (https://airflow.apache.org), for example images, nodeSelector, tolerations, env, secret, extraEnvFrom, config, scheduler/apiServer/triggerer/dagProcessor resources, dags.gitSync. Refused: fullnameOverride, nameOverride, useStandardNaming, airflowVersion, executor, extraEnv (use env, secret or extraEnvFrom), apiServer.apiServerConfig/apiServerConfigConfigMapName, config.core.auth_manager, ingress.enabled, ingress.apiServer.enabled/ingressClassName/host/hosts/tls, data, fernetKey, apiSecretKey, jwtSecret, webserverSecretKey and their *SecretName, redis.enabled, postgresql.enabled, migrateDatabaseJob.enabled/useHelmHooks/jobAnnotations, createUserJob.enabled. Appended to the lists this chart sets: volumes, volumeMounts, dags.gitSync.env.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
